facts.fact: Replit's vendor documentation says Replit Agent turns plain-language ideas into apps, designs, slides, and more, and that no coding is required.
facts.quote: Replit Agent turns your ideas into apps, designs, slides, and more, all from plain language. No coding required.

facts.fact: According to Replit's vendor documentation, Replit Agent can pull data from connected services such as BigQuery, Slack, or Notion.
According to Replit's vendor documentation, a single Replit project can contain multiple artifact types, so a web app, mobile app, slides, or video can be added later in the same project.
facts.quote: Start with a web app and add a mobile app, slides, or a video later — all in the same project.

facts.fact: Replit's vendor documentation lists Free, Power, and Max as the Agent modes that control how Agent builds a project.
facts.quote: The Agent modes popover with Free, Power, and Max modes.

facts.fact: Replit Agent's Free Mode provides no-cost everyday Agent work within the plan's allowance, and the Core and Pro allowances reset every five hours and have weekly limits.
facts.quote: The Core and Pro allowances reset every five hours and have weekly limits.

facts.fact: Replit Agent's Starter tier keeps its existing limits under the Free Mode description.
facts.quote: The Starter tier keeps its existing limits.

facts.fact: Replit describes Power mode as a paid, mid-tier Agent mode with powerful models at an affordable price.
facts.quote: **Power**: A paid, mid-tier mode with powerful models at an affordable price.

facts.fact: Replit describes Max mode as a paid, top-tier Agent mode with the best frontier models for the most demanding work.
facts.quote: **Max**: A paid, top-tier mode with the best frontier models for the most demanding work.

facts.fact: Replit Agent may offer a paid 'Allow once' option when a request needs more capability than Free Mode, and Replit asks for confirmation before a paid action starts.
facts.quote: Replit asks for confirmation before a paid action starts, and Agent returns to Free Mode afterward.

facts.fact: On Replit Agent's availability table, Core and Pro plans have 1 and 10 active background tasks respectively.
Enterprise workspaces on Replit use one Auto mode instead of Free Mode, and account admins can manage model access with Enterprise model controls.
facts.quote: Enterprise workspaces use one Auto mode instead of Free Mode.

facts.fact: Replit Agent's Auto mode provides automatic model selection for paid work in Power or Max on Core and Pro plans.
facts.quote: **Auto**: Automatic model selection for paid work in Power or Max on Core and Pro.

facts.fact: Replit's availability table lists 1 active background task for the Core plan.
Replit's Agent modes UI describes Turbo as offering the fastest models, with Replit stating up to 2.5x speed and 6x cost.
facts.quote: Fastest models, up to 2.5x speed and 6x cost

facts.fact: Replit defines Auto as automatic model selection for paid work in Power or Max modes on the Core and Pro plans.
facts.quote: Automatic model selection for paid work in Power or Max on Core and Pro.

facts.fact: Replit's availability table shows Power mode and Max mode as available on both the Core and Pro plans.
Replit's Agent overview page is titled 'Introducing Replit Agent 4' in its embedded video.
